collection.title: Volvo S40 2004 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Volvo S40 2004 to 2006 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
